environment.description: Go 1.19 microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in us-east-1, behind an internal ALB with no WAF attached. Service runs in a private subnet with security group allowing inbound from VPC CIDR on port 8080. The ECS task role has basic CloudWatch Logs and ECR pull permissions. No request filtering or header sanitization is performed at the load balancer layer. The ALB forwards raw HTTP/1.1 connections to the target group.

config.load_balancer: Internal ALB, no WAF, HTTP listener on port 80 forwarding to target group port 8080
config.network: Private subnet, SG allows VPC CIDR inbound
